name: Family Safety Monitor
tagline: Keeps a parent posted on which apps a child uses, without reading their messages
description: Parents usually learn about a new app long after a child starts using it. Drawing on the places that already record this, such as viewing history, Family Link and Screen Time exports, it builds a picture of what gets opened and how often, then reports the shifts worth knowing. Private conversations stay out of scope.
author: KevinTweets1
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
